name: airbrake_groups_update
title: Update Airbrake error group state
description: Change the state of an Airbrake error group: mute, unmute, resolve, unresolve (PUT, no body). resolve/unresolve follow the mute/unmute PUT convention but are not in the public docs — fall back to airbrake_request if they fail on your instance. group_id MUST be passed as a string (19-digit snowflake). Disabled when AIRBRAKE_READ_ONLY is set. Returns the raw Airbrake JSON payload — no data is removed.

action.description: State change to apply to the group
